B21 l.975–979 asserts j∘i⁻¹(W) ⊆ U from I⁺(q′) ∩ I⁻(j(bₙ)) ⊂ U, but the argument only gives j(W) ⊆ J⁺(q′) ∩ J⁻(j(bₙ)) (a limit of chronological relations is causal), so the step needs the CAUSAL diamonds J(q′, j(bₙ)) to shrink into U: true in a GH M₂ (compact, nested, intersection {q′} by causality and closedness of J^±); formalized that way (WP-43c). Likewise q′ is only a cluster point of the decreasing j(bₙ) a priori; uniqueness is not needed.

B21 l.980 'W is the regular part of a neighborhood of some point of sing(E₀)': W = I⁺(p) ∩ I⁻(bₙ) contains no neighbourhood of p itself; it contains the regular part of a neighbourhood of a BTZ point z strictly above p on the line, close enough to p to lie in I⁻(bₙ) (exists_sing_above, exists_nhds_diff_sing_subset_Iplus via SingularPastAt and Iplus_of_lt). Proved.

The holonomy step (l.980–984, 'a non trivial loop of parabolic holonomy') is done without loops: GX.e0_localUnique_sing (B21 prop:isom_strong at α = β = 0) extends the injective structomorphism f read in charts (target a chart of the maximal a.e. atlas of 𝔼₀ after a translation) across the singular point, and the extension would send it into the compact regular closure of the image (exists_nhds_not_mapsTo).

findings: Direction (ii)⇒(i) is sorry-free and (i)⇒(ii) reduces exactly to lemma K's local input: the paper's covering-space argument (φ a covering, ψ a section, π₁ onto, O'Neill Lemma 45, intersection numbers) is not needed once the image of the compact Cauchy surface is locally Cauchy.

The connectedness of a compact acausal Cauchy surface of a connected GH spacetime (needed by lemma K; implicit in B21, whose Σ is a genus-g surface) holds without any splitting: isConnected_of_isCauchySurface_abstract (model-free: tarentin, causally arc-connected, CurvesExtend, T2).

B21 l.1044–1046's definition of E_A-maximality, read literally (no connectedness of N), is satisfied by NO nonempty M: for any nonempty globally hyperbolic E_A-manifold M', the inclusion M ↪ M ⊔ M' is an embedding (an a.e. E-morphism) into a globally hyperbolic E_A-manifold (causal relations do not cross components, so it stays causal with compact diamonds) and is not onto. Hence the 'without loss of generality … M and N are connected' of l.1058 is not without loss of generality: connectedness of N must be part of the definition. IsE0Maximal builds it in. Counterexample given in prose, not formalized (would need the 𝔼₀-atlas of a disjoint union).
